title: rectangle
body:
## rectangle

Create a fully constrained rectangular profile with editable width and height in an explicit frame or checked planar-face attachment. Profiles may belong to one Body, use an independent XY/XZ/YZ or explicit orthonormal frame, or attach to a uniquely checked extreme planar face of their current support. Rectangle/circle constraints retain editable dimensions; polygon fixes its ordered lines. See the history guide for attachment directions and topology limits.

Native binding: `Sketcher::SketchObject`. Output kind: `["profile"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | no | `body` |
| `support` | one node | no | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | Side length along the sketch's first axis (world X on XY and XZ, world Y on YZ), in millimetres; the rectangle spans ±width/2 about origin. Stored as the sketch constraint named width. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `80` |
| `height` | Side length along the sketch's second axis (world Y on XY, world Z on XZ and YZ), in millimetres; the rectangle spans ±height/2 about origin. Stored as the sketch constraint named height. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `50` |
| `plane` | World plane containing the rectangle. XY maps sketch u, v to world X, Y (normal +Z); XZ maps them to X, Z (normal along −Y); YZ maps them to Y, Z (normal +X). Pick the plane perpendicular to the intended extrusion direction. | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY","XZ","YZ"]}` | `"XY"` |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the rectangle's centre (the sketch placement). | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `frame` | An independent right-handed sketch frame: origin in world mm, perpendicular unit xAxis and normal, with local Y defined as normal cross xAxis. Use this instead of plane/origin or onFace; it remains a native placement rather than a linked attachment. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"origin":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"xAxis":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"normal":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true}}}` | omitted |
| `onFace` | Native planar-face attachment intent, paired with support. Select one extreme outward-facing planar face by semantic direction, anchor and offset; ambiguous or missing faces fail. The persisted native support link follows compatible native support edits. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"face":{"type":"enum","values":["top","bottom","right","left","back","front"],"required":true},"position":{"type":"enum","values":["outermost","innermost"],"default":"outermost"},"anchor":{"type":"enum","values":["projectOrigin","centroid"],"default":"projectOrigin"},"offset":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000,"default":0}}}` | omitted |
